mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k signals stronger corporate earnings momentum, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-200k payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 4-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 900k signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST < 900k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 98 signals slowing manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO < 98 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressures and reduces profit margins, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE < 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures below $400B signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces GDP growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of RSAFS < 400 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% signals a synchronized labor market tightening, which raises wage pressures and reduces profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for 3 months AND UNRATE < 5.5% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
